Priya: Heads-up We need to finalize the reserved-pool quota semantics for the upcoming Dedicated pilot wave. Key open items: credit carryover, per-tenant soft vs hard caps, fairshare during simultaneous bursts, and a small API for quota introspection. Anyone object to a short working session tomorrow?
Ethan: No objection. Quick preference: customers asked for some carryover of unused burst credits between billing periods (monthly). I'd recommend capped carryover (e.g., up to 25% of monthly allowance) rather than unlimited.
Rafi: Agree on cap. Also we should define precise time windows: carryover should be single-step (last-month -> next-month) only; otherwise bookkeeping gets messy.
Tess: From UX side we need: 1) console panel showing current month, carryover applied, projected burn rate; 2) API endpoint GET /v1/dedicated/quotas/{tenant} returning {allocated, used, carryover, available}. Keep it simple.
Priya: Ops implications: implementing carryover means billing export needs a carryover line item and adjusted daily burn calculation. Ops ask: we must also emit an event when carryover is consumed.
Ethan: Fairshare during bursts: customers want predictable behavior when multiple tenants burst simultaneously. Proposal: multilayer fairness: reserved-guaranteed first, then proportional soft-burst sharing weighted by reserve size, finally throttling. Put preemption only at the last layer.
Rafi: Implementation note: proportional sharing means we need a per-pool weighted token bucket. Complexity: ensure we avoid oscillations when multiple tenants start/stop quickly. Suggest smoothing window 30s to 2m.
Tess: UX/Docs: call the feature "soft-burst sharing" and explain with an example table. Example: Tenant A reserve=10units, B=5units; both burst by 20units. Shared allocation proportion = 10:5 so A gets 13.3 units, B gets 6.7 units of shared pool (before capping by carryover/credits).
Priya: API change note: quota introspection must expose reason codes for limits: REASON_RESERVED, REASON_SOFT_BURST_EXHAUSTED, REASON_GLOBAL_THROTTLE. This helps clients decide to retry or degrade.
Ethan: Billing models for pilot: option 1 prepaid monthly burst credits with carryover cap; option 2 overage billing per-unit. For accounting we need a canonical unit (GPU-minutes or token-minutes?). Ops suggests using GPU-minutes for now since it's closest to infra costs.
Rafi: Kernel-level concern: short bursts may have a non-linear cost due to model warmup. Need to document that "burst unit" is computed as weighted GPU-minute where weight accounts for model warmup factor. We'll need experiments.
Tess: Acceptance criteria suggestion for pilot:
- Quota semantics implemented: reserved, soft-burst, carryover cap applied
- Introspection API returns accurate numbers within 5% error at 1min resolution
- Fairshare allocator respects weights and smoothing window, no >30% oscillation in allocation between 10s windows during synthetic burst tests
- Billing export contains carryover and burst_usage line items and matches console numbers
- Docs + sample API snippets published
Priya: Rollout plan: two-week dev spike to implement core allocator + API, followed by internal dogfood one-week, then four pilots (each 2-week, overlapping) with progressively stricter gates. Gate metrics: p95 latency change <= 15%, preempt_rate <= 0.5% of requests, billing reconciliation within 48h.
Ethan: Monitoring checklist: per-tenant: reserved_used, soft_burst_used, carryover_consumed, fairshare_alloc, throttle_events. Per-pool: total_burst_inflight, allocation_variance. Alert: reconciliation drift > 1% daily -> page oncall.
Rafi: Dev tasks: implement weighted token-bucket allocator (ETA 2 wks), add smoothing and stabilization logic (ETA +1 wk), add telemetry for carryover events (ETA 1 wk), integrate with billing export (ETA 2 wks).
Tess: I'll prepare UI mocks for carryover display and soft-burst table. ETA 5 business days. Also draft two sample API responses for docs.
Priya: Legal/contract ask: pilots must include a short addendum that clarifies carryover behavior and that guaranteed sessions are excluded from carryover. I've looped LegalBot for wording.
LegalBot: Noted. I'll prepare a pilot addendum template and return with suggested language by EOD tomorrow.
OpsBot: Deploy job queued: rollout/dedicated/quotas/spike-allocator -> staging at 1769991255 :wrench:
Ethan: One more operational detail: suggest a CLI command to let support temporarily credit a tenant for testing: `redwood-cli dedicated credit --tenant TID --amount 100 --reason "pilot-test"`. Need audit trail.
Priya: Good call. Add audit_log event for manual credit adjustments. Also require 2-person approval for credits > 10k units.
Rafi: Edge-case: what happens for cross-pool model routing when tenant reserve isn't available but model exists in another pool with spare capacity? Decision: allow cross-pool borrowing only if customer enabled cross-pool fallback; otherwise only fairshare within pool. Need consent flag per-tenant.
Tess: Add that opt-in in console under "routing & fallbacks". Default off.
Priya: Great. If no objections I'll run the dev spike tomorrow morning. Please add any blockers here before EOD.
Ethan: None from me.
Rafi: None.
Tess: None.
OpsBot: Staging deploy started: rollout/dedicated/quotas/spike-allocator v0.1 -> staging at 1769991265 :rocket:
Priya: Thanks all Let's sync after the dev spike for dogfood plan."
